compute via spins\n    tot=0\n    for c in range(2**N):\n        s=1-2*((c>>np.arange(N))&1)\n        w=1\n        for k,(x,y,d) in enumerate(edges):\n            v=sid(x+1,y) if d=='E' else sid(x,y+1)\n            w*=(1+t[k]*s[sid(x,y)]*s[v])\n        tot+=w\n    return tot/2**N\nrng=np.random.default_rng(0)\nts=[rng.uniform(-.5,.8,len(edges)) for _ in range(3)]\nZs=[even_gen(t) for t in ts]\nprint(Zs)\npairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(4),2))\ndef build(t,loc,oE,oN,a,b):\n    A=np.zeros((4*N,4*N))\n    for i in range(N):\n        for (p,q),s in zip(pairs,loc): A[4*i+p,4*i+q]=s; A[4*i+q,4*i+p]=-s\n    for k,(x,y,d) in enumerate(edges):\n        if d=='E': u,v,sg=4*sid(x,y)+0,4*sid(x+1,y)+1,oE*(a if x==W-1 else 1)\n        else: u,v,sg=4*sid(x,y)+2,4*sid(x,y+1)+3,oN*(b if y==H-1 else 1)\n        A[u,v]=t[k]*sg; cat > ising.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np, itertools, heapq\nfrom pfapack import ctypes as pc\nLOC=(-1,-1,1,1,1,1); CS=[(1,1,.5),(1,-1,.5),(-1,1,-.5),(-1,-1,.5)]\nPAIRS=list(itertools.combinations(range(4),2))\ndef pf10(A):\n    r=pc.pfaffian(np.asfortranarray(A),method='P',sign_only=False) if False else None\nclass Model:\n    def __init__(s,W,H,edges,fsites,mref):\n        s.W,s.H,s.N=W,H,W*H; s.edges=edges; s.fs=fsites; s.nE=len(edges); s.nF=len(fsites)\n        sid=lambda x,y:(y%H)*W+(x%W); s.sid=sid\n        s.ends=[]; s.uv=[]; s.seam=[]\n        for (x,y,d) in edges:\n            if d=='E': a,b=sid(x,y),sid(x+1,y); u,v=4*a+0,4*b+1; sm=(x==W-1,0)\n            else: a,b=sid(x,y),sid(x,y+1); u,v=4*a+2,4*b+3; sm=(0,y==H-1)\n            s.ends.append((a,b)); s.uv.append((u,v)); s.seam.append(sm)\n        s.u=np.array([p[0] for p in s.uv]); s.v=np.array([p[1] for p in s.uv])\n        # tree: dijkstra from fsite 0 with cost -log|m|\n        adj={}\n        for k,(a,b) in enumerate(s.ends):\n            c=-np.log(max(abs(mref[k]),1e-3))\n            adj.setdefault(a,[]).append((b,k,c)); adj.setdefault(b,[]).append((a,k,c))\n        root=sid(*fsites[0]); dist={root:0}; par={}; pq=[(0,root)]\n        while pq:\n            d0,a=heapq.heappop(pq)\n            if d0>dist[a]: continue\n            for b,k,c in adj[a]:\n                if d0+c<dist.get(b,1e99): dist[b]=d0+c; par[b]=(a,k); heapq.heappush(pq,(d0+c,b))\n        tree={}  # edge -> bitmask of fsites downstream\n        for j,(x,y) in enumerate(fsites):\n            a=sid(x,y)\n            while a!=root:\n                p,k=par[a];
